summary.headline: IndiaMART Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 11% YoY to Rs 414 crore with 35% EBITDA margin, while paying suppliers fell by 1,850 QoQ to 2.18 lakh.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations grew about 11% YoY to Rs 414 crore and EBITDA was Rs 146 crore (35% margin), supported by lower customer acquisition spend and operating leverage. Collections grew 8% to Rs 463 crore and deferred revenue grew 16% to Rs 2,014 crore. Paying suppliers fell by a net 1,850 in the quarter to 2.18 lakh, driven by weaker gross additions and elevated Silver-tier churn. Management said buyer enquiries were flattish at about 26-27 million, with roughly 4-5% of the decline attributed to new OTP verification; it also flagged BUSY billing growth of only 10% (about 30% normalised) and a new finance subsidiary.

financial_highlights.change: Driven by mark-to-market gains on treasury portfolio
Net decline of 1,850 in the quarter

segments.name: IndiaMART marketplace
segments.commentary: Platinum and Gold subscribers are about 50% of the customer base and more than 75% of revenue, with good upsell and retention per management. Silver monthly churn was about 7%, unchanged per management.

segments.name: BUSY Infotech
segments.commentary: Billing about Rs 59 crore (+10% YoY); revenue from operations Rs 36 crore (+47%); deferred revenue Rs 146 crore (+44%); cash from operations about Rs 16 crore. About 12 thousand new licences sold, taking the cumulative count to 4.54 lakh.

guidance_outlook: Management said BUSY normalised billing growth is about 30% after removing a one-time Rs 10 crore win-back benefit in Q1 FY26; normalised revenue/deferred growth seen at 30-40%.
Over the next couple of years BUSY CAGR is expected at 27-30%; longer-term aspiration is 35-40% CAGR.
BUSY licence growth targeted at 15-20% in the next year or two as the business migrates from licensing to subscription.
Paid buyer programme is an experiment; management said free buyer access will remain free.
Segmented verification and churn containment expected to show results after about a year.
capex_capacity: Board approved creation of wholly owned subsidiary IndiaMART Finance Limited for short-term transaction financing via partnership lenders; management said no large lending from own balance sheet.
Advertising spend of about Rs 7-8 crore per quarter, targeted at top 10% monetisable categories; expansion to Meta, Instagram and YouTube planned.
AI voice call centre handles over 1 lakh calls per day, up from about 80 thousand manual calls per day previously.
Follow-on investments in Bizom, Fleetx, SuperProcure and Aerchain; management cited a 10% per-company limit on follow-ons.
demand_pricing: Unique business enquiries about 26-27 million, flattish QoQ; analyst cited an 11% decline and management attributed about 4-5% of the decline to OTP verification.
Active buyers down about 5%; about 40 million total active buyers, of which about 10 million are GST or verified business buyers.
Management described a shortage of enquiries as quality improved; 90-day buyer repeat rate at 58-59% (up from 50-51% over the years).
Management is pursuing category-based pricing and tiered pricing for Platinum plans.
Management said Google traffic is under pressure from LLM tools; LLM traffic attribution is not yet measurable.

qa_highlights.question: What is the purpose of IndiaMART Finance Limited and will it lend from its own balance sheet?
qa_highlights.answer: Objective is transaction financing via partnership lenders for short-term products; no plans for large lending from own balance sheet.

qa_highlights.question: Why have collections in BUSY grown more slowly this quarter?
qa_highlights.answer: Q1 FY26 included about Rs 10 crore of one-time win-backs; excluding that, growth is about 30%, with deferred and recognised revenue growing 30-40%.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the buyer count declining and what is being done?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cut low-quality buyers earlier and now targets higher-ARPU categories with about Rs 7-8 crore per quarter of advertising; organic buyer decline partly linked to Google-to-LLM traffic shift.

qa_highlights.question: What initiatives beyond sales process changes will curb churn and improve gross adds?
qa_highlights.answer: Better supplier quality, catalogue and category curation, buyer quality via fill-rate, and credit embedded into transactions through the finance subsidiary.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the enquiry decline is due to verification versus traffic migration?
qa_highlights.answer: About 4-5% of the decline is from OTP verification; management could not quantify the rest, which may include LLM migration or macro factors.

qa_highlights.question: Are follow-on investments and new stakes planned given the cash balance?
qa_highlights.answer: Follow-ons continue on merit in Bizom, Fleetx, SuperProcure and Aerchain; no fixed rupee target was given and new strategic investments are limited.

risks_watch: Paying supplier base fell by 1,850 QoQ; Silver monthly churn at about 7%, with first-12-month cohorts the main problem.
Buyer and enquiry volumes are flattish to declining, with Google-driven acquisition under pressure from LLM tools.
Earnings are boosted by Rs 107 crore other income from treasury mark-to-market gains, versus Rs 146 crore EBITDA.
BUSY billing growth of 10% reported, with normalised growth around 30%; license growth is about 10%.
Watch the rollout of IndiaMART Finance Limited and the buyer paid programme, and whether gross supplier additions recover.
summary.management_tone: Confident on margins, BUSY deferred revenue and product/AI initiatives, but cautious and at times evasive on buyer declines, churn timing and LLM traffic impact, repeatedly saying outcomes are uncertain or will take time.
key_quotes: Margins continued to be elevated on account of savings arising from lower customer acquisition and operating leverage.
Now there is a shortage of buy leads or shortage of enquiry.
Most of the churn or retention problem is limited to the first-year onboarding itself.
We do not have any plans to lend out of our own balance sheet any large amount.

growth.why: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue grew about 11% YoY, but the brief gives no formal revenue guidance; enquiries are flattish at 26-27 million, paying suppliers fell net 1,850, and the outlook rests on BUSY CAGR of 27-30% and pricing initiatives without specific capacity or orders behind it.
